evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We find that a dedicated encoder is essential: with one, a 4B model surpasses GPT-4o on every perception attribute we test, whereas textualizing the series costs 8--10 points in reasoning accuracy.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we build the first such suite, with 337K training and 44K evaluation samples across three progressive capabilities, Perceive, Solve, and Reason, and use it to ask how time series should enter an LLM that must master all three, and in what order.
